sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.10018 of 2024
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
"....to issue writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in non disbursing the compensation of Rs.2,01,630-00 with interest in pursuance of the award vide Proceedings No. B1/350/2018, Award No. 2/2022 dated 16.12.2022 for the acquisition of the land in survey No. 383 extent ac.0.06 gts situated at Jangaoon village, Ramagundam mandal, Peddapally Distric for the last 1  year as arbitrary and illegal and in violation of the provisions of the Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 and consequently to direct the respondents to disburse the compensation awarded as per the Proceedings No. B1/350/2018, Award No.2/2022 dated 16.12.2022..."

2. It is the case of the petitioner that his land admeasuring Ac.0.06 gts in Sy.No.383, situated at Jangaon Village, Ramagundam Mandal, Peddapalli District, was acquired by the respondents for the GDK Open Cast Project (RGOC-V), Ramagundam Area-I, of Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL).

The grievance of the petitioner is that despite determination of compensation and passing of award vide Proceedings No. B1/350/2018, Award No. 2/2022, dated 16.12.2022, the respondents are not paying the compensation amount for the acquired land.

3. The learned counsel for the respondent No.5 has submitted that as per the demand notice dated 23.11.2021 issued by the respondent no. 2, the respondent No.5 has deposited funds to the tune of Rs. 6,05,04,718-00 with the respondent no.2 vide letter no. RG.I/EST/LA/RGOCV/21/871, dated 28.12.2021 towards probable compensation for passing of award.

It is stated that the respondent no.2 has passed award for Acs.36-04 gts vide award Proceedings No. B1/350/2018, dated 16.12.2022, wherein the land to an extent of Acs.0-06 gts in Sy. No. 383 situated in Janagaon Village was covered in the apportionment of the name of the petitioner for Rs.2,01,630- 00 as compensation.
It is submitted that the disbursement of compensation amount lies with the respondent No.2 and therefore, the writ petition against the respondent No.5 is not maintainable.

4. The learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondent Nos.1 to 4 has produced the copy of FORM-CC, relating to payment of land compensation to the awardees in the limits of Jangaon Village of Ramagundam Mandal, Peddpalli District, (Ac.36.04 gts) as per Award No.02/2022 & Proceedings No.B1/350/2018 dated 16.12.2022 and submitted that the Bhupelli Naga Srinivas vs The State Of Telangana on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46419272/
1 compensation amount of Rs.2,01,630/- has been deposited in the bank account of the petitioner and the petitioner has also subscribed his signature on FORM-CC.
5.

sentences.text: In view of the above submissions, since the compensation amount has already been paid to the petitioner, this Writ Petition is closed, as no further orders are necessary.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
